headline_marked: 4-match ban: [[Vinicius Junior to miss Clasico]] after hair-pulling red card
headline: 4-match ban: Vinicius Junior to miss Clasico after hair-pulling red card
summary: The Real Madrid star is suspended for four games following violent behavior and protests during a match against Villarreal.
details: Real Madrid winger Vinicius Junior has been handed a four-match suspension by the Spanish football federation's disciplinary committee.
The ban follows a red card issued for hair-pulling against Villarreal last week, as well as subsequent protests toward match officials.
The committee cited 'violent behavior' for a two-game ban and an additional two matches for his protests, totaling four games.
As a result, Vinicius will miss the high-profile Clasico against Barcelona on October 25, as well as matches against Sevilla, Racing Santander, and Valencia.
The incident occurred about 20 minutes after Vinicius was introduced as a substitute, during which a goal he scored was also overturned by VAR.
Following the match, Vinicius apologized to his teammates and supporters on social media, stating, 'I am sorry to the team and the fans.'
Real Madrid remains six points behind league leaders Barcelona, who currently hold a perfect record of 10 wins from 10 matches.
caption:
A massive blow for Real Madrid! Vinicius Junior is banned for 4 matches and will miss the legendary Clasico.

Real Madrid winger Vinicius Junior has been handed a four-match suspension by the Spanish football federation's disciplinary committee.

The ban follows a red card issued for hair-pulling against Villarreal last week, as well as subsequent protests toward match officials.

The committee cited 'violent behavior' for a two-game ban and an additional two matches for his protests, totaling four games.

As a result, Vinicius will miss the high-profile Clasico against Barcelona on October 25, as well as matches against Sevilla, Racing Santander, and Valencia.

The incident occurred about 20 minutes after Vinicius was introduced as a substitute, during which a goal he scored was also overturned by VAR.

Following the match, Vinicius apologized to his teammates and supporters on social media, stating, 'I am sorry to the team and the fans.'

Real Madrid remains six points behind league leaders Barcelona, who currently hold a perfect record of 10 wins from 10 matches.

headline: 3 late goals: Real Madrid stun Roma 4-3 in wild Champions League clash
summary: The 15-time European champions completed an astonishing comeback, scoring three goals in the final six minutes to secure an away win.
details: Real Madrid secured a dramatic 4-3 away victory over Roma in the Champions League on Wednesday, scoring three goals in the final six minutes of the match.
Roma took an early lead through Marten de Roon in the 20th minute, but Kylian Mbappe scored on his 100th Champions League appearance to level the scores before halftime.
The Italians surged ahead again in the second half with two goals from Donyell Malen in six minutes, leaving Real Madrid trailing 3-1.
The turnaround began in the final six minutes when Carlos Espi scored from a corner rebound, followed by a header from Endrick two minutes later.
Antonio Rudiger delivered the final blow in the 90th minute, guiding home a close-range finish to complete the extraordinary comeback.
The match was also a reunion for Jose Mourinho, who was honored by the Roma crowd despite the match being against his current team.
Real Madrid now have six points from their opening two league phase matches, while Roma remains on one point.
caption:
From 3-1 down to a 4-3 win in just six minutes! Real Madrid's comeback is pure madness.

Real Madrid secured a dramatic 4-3 away victory over Roma in the Champions League on Wednesday, scoring three goals in the final six minutes of the match.

Roma took an early lead through Marten de Roon in the 20th minute, but Kylian Mbappe scored on his 100th Champions League appearance to level the scores before halftime.

The Italians surged ahead again in the second half with two goals from Donyell Malen in six minutes, leaving Real Madrid trailing 3-1.

The turnaround began in the final six minutes when Carlos Espi scored from a corner rebound, followed by a header from Endrick two minutes later.

Antonio Rudiger delivered the final blow in the 90th minute, guiding home a close-range finish to complete the extraordinary comeback.

The match was also a reunion for Jose Mourinho, who was honored by the Roma crowd despite the match being against his current team.

Real Madrid now have six points from their opening two league phase matches, while Roma remains on one point.
